summary: Lemhi County, Idaho, lookout site on the Salmon National Forest; only a 1924 forest report and newspaper item describe it. No build date or status found.

events.note: 1924 forest report: site visited daily during fire season. The lookout's camp was at Axe Park; the entry does not explain how Axe Park relates to the mountain.

evidence.supports: Entry lists the agency as Salmon National Forest
Index spells the name Alan Mountain
1924 forest report: site visited daily during fire season
evidence.quote: 1924: A Salmon Forest lookout report shows the site to be visited daily during fire season.

evidence.supports: Lookout's camp located at Axe Park
evidence.quote: The lookout had a camp located at Axe Park.

evidence.supports: Salmon Herald item dated August 20, 1924: a son stationed at the Axe Park lookout, mother and daughter camping with him
evidence.quote: Mrs. LaMunyan and daughter, Mabel, have been camping out with her son, Joe, who is stationed at Axe Park lookout.

evidence.supports: Forest Service calls the forest Salmon-Challis National Forest
evidence.quote: Salmon-Challis National Forest | Fire Lookouts | Forest Service

evidence.supports: Forest Service built, maintained and staffed up to 50 lookout locations since 1908
evidence.quote: Since their establishment in 1908 the Forest Service around Salmon and Challis have built, maintained and staffed up to 50 different lookout locations around the forest.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The index spells the name Alan Mountain; the entry heading spells it Allan Mountain. The brief's spelling Allan is kept.

sources.title: Fire Lookouts
sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Salmon-Challis National Forest

notes_for_editor: One source describes the site: the Idaho lookout website entry, which has only 1924 items. No build date, type, height, status or access found. Two WebSearch rounds and the Bing Young 1982 overview (idahoaclimbingguide.com) gave nothing specific. The Bing Young overview says lookout structures stood in 1924 only on Long Tom, Baldy, Taylor, Stein and Blackbird Mountain, and does not name Allan. The FFLA Idaho lookout table (firelookout.org/?p=1128) has no Allan or Alan row. The entry's Axe Park camp may mean a camp, not a structure on the mountain. Brief kind and status 'unknown' are kept. Worth a human check with the Salmon-Challis office.
